store_tracking_intro: Watch benchmark and trending stores: what they listed recently, which new listings started selling, and where the store is heading. The store pool is per workspace; listings and observations are shared across the deployment.
store_tracking_run_round_hint: Processes only this workspace's stores and tracked products, ignoring schedules. Collection tasks go through the sync queue and the budget ledger, and this works while scheduled pipelines are paused. At most one round per workspace per hour.
store_tracking_round_queued: Queued. Refresh in a few minutes to see results.
store_tracking_round_already: A round is already queued this hour. Try again later.
store_tracking_round_unavailable: The store tracking queue is not enabled in this deployment.
store_tracking_ebay_not_configured: eBay source is not configured: eBay stores are not discovering new listings; Amazon stores are tracked as usual.
store_tracking_amazon_not_configured: The Amazon data source (DataForSEO / AIsa) is not configured: Amazon stores are not discovering new listings; eBay stores are tracked as usual.
store_tracking_link_placeholder: Paste an eBay store page or Amazon seller page link
store_tracking_link_hint: Supports ebay.com/str/…, ebay.com/usr/…, eBay search links with _ssn=, and Amazon links with seller= or me=.
store_tracking_keywords_hint: Amazon stores are discovered through these search terms; when empty, the linked directions' keywords are used. One per line or comma-separated.
store_tracking_name_hint: Amazon offers are attributed by seller ID or seller name; entering the store's on-page name improves matching.
store_tracking_empty_hint: Paste a store link; new listings are discovered daily and sales are tracked.
store_tracking_remove_confirm: The store will no longer be tracked; discovered listings and history are kept. Remove it?
store_tracking_coverage_amazon: Discovery: keyword coverage, incomplete. Amazon has no free API for a seller's full catalog; the system checks offers on search results for these terms, so only listings these terms surface are found.
store_tracking_coverage_ebay: Discovery: the official eBay Browse API fetches the seller's new listings incrementally.
store_tracking_coverage_no_keywords: No search terms yet: add them in settings or link a direction with keywords.
store_tracking_coverage_found: {count} products found in the last 30 days
store_tracking_metrics_sample: Sample: {count} new listings; metrics stay empty below 5.
store_tracking_listings_empty: No listings found for this store yet
store_tracking_read_only: You can view the store pool; changes require a workspace owner or admin and a writable workspace.
